content.grammarNotesEn: Countable wood; woods common.

exactRecord.actualReviewNote: Place noun distinct from timber.

content.definitionEn: Soft hair from sheep, used to make yarn and cloth.

examples.vi: Chăn được dệt từ len.

content.grammarNotesEn: Uncountable material; source core sheep fibre.

exactRecord.actualReviewNote: Material no media provenance claimed.

content.definitionEn: All the people working for a company or in a particular area.

examples.vi: Lực lượng lao động của nhà máy đã tăng.

content.grammarNotesEn: Collective countable noun.

exactRecord.actualReviewNote: Worker population, not single worker.

content.definitionEn: Feeling anxious about a possible problem.

examples.vi: Cô ấy có vẻ lo về kỳ thi.

content.grammarNotesEn: Worried about.

exactRecord.actualReviewNote: Concern feeling, not worrying cause adjective.

content.definitionEn: A particular problem or thought that causes anxiety.

examples.vi: Nỗi lo chính của anh ấy là tài liệu bị mất.

content.grammarNotesEn: Countable; a worry.

exactRecord.actualReviewNote: Countable cause, not general emotion.

content.definitionEn: A feeling of anxiety about something.

examples.en: Worry kept her awake.
examples.vi: Sự lo lắng khiến cô ấy thức.

content.grammarNotesEn: Usually uncountable state.

exactRecord.actualReviewNote: Emotion state distinct from specific concern.

content.definitionEn: To feel anxious about a possible problem.

examples.en: Try not to worry about the delay.
examples.vi: Hãy cố đừng lo về sự chậm trễ.

content.grammarNotesEn: Worry about; no treatment advice.

exactRecord.actualReviewNote: Feeling verb, not problem noun.

content.definitionEn: Religious acts expressing reverence for a deity or sacred figure.

examples.vi: Tòa nhà được dùng cho việc thờ phụng.

content.grammarNotesEn: Uncountable activity.

exactRecord.actualReviewNote: Not merely liking; religious core maintained.

content.definitionEn: To show religious reverence through belief or practice.

examples.en: The community worships in the small temple.
examples.vi: Cộng đồng thờ phụng tại ngôi đền nhỏ.

content.grammarNotesEn: Transitive or intransitive.

exactRecord.actualReviewNote: Religious practice not automatically prayer alone.

content.definitionEn: To grapple with another person, trying to hold or throw them, especially in a sport.

examples.vi: Các vận động viên đấu vật trên thảm.

content.grammarNotesEn: Wrestle with someone; sport context.

exactRecord.actualReviewNote: Source physical contest only, not abstract difficulty.

content.definitionEn: The joint connecting the hand to the forearm.

examples.en: The bracelet slipped over her wrist.
examples.vi: Chiếc vòng trượt qua cổ tay cô ấy.

content.grammarNotesEn: Countable; history protected.

exactRecord.actualReviewNote: Anatomical location not medical advice.

content.definitionEn: The period covered by a year's school or college programme.

content.grammarNotesEn: Countable; institution-specific calendar.

exactRecord.actualReviewNote: Academic programme period distinct from full calendar duration.

content.definitionEn: A period of twelve months.

examples.en: The project lasted a year.
examples.vi: Dự án kéo dài một năm.

content.grammarNotesEn: Countable; leap-year days vary.

exactRecord.actualReviewNote: Avoided universal 365-day assertion.

content.definitionEn: To speak or cry out very loudly.

examples.en: He yelled to be heard above the noise.
examples.vi: Anh ấy hét lên để người khác nghe được giữa tiếng ồn.

content.grammarNotesEn: Yell at person or yell for help.

exactRecord.actualReviewNote: Loudness, anger not essential.

exactRecord.before: Anh ấy hét lên để át tiếng ồn.

content.definitionEn: On the day before today.

examples.en: The parcel arrived yesterday.
examples.vi: Bưu kiện đến hôm qua.

content.grammarNotesEn: Time adverb.

exactRecord.actualReviewNote: Event-time adverb distinct from day noun.

content.definitionEn: The day before today.

examples.en: Yesterday was unusually quiet.
examples.vi: Ngày hôm qua yên tĩnh khác thường.

content.grammarNotesEn: Noun as subject.

exactRecord.actualReviewNote: Nominal day explicit.

content.definitionEn: To stop resisting a demand or opposing force.

examples.vi: Cô ấy từ chối nhượng bộ trước sức ép.

content.grammarNotesEn: Yield to someone or something.

exactRecord.actualReviewNote: Negative faithful; not traffic instruction.

content.definitionEn: The amount of a crop or product produced.

examples.vi: Sản lượng của vườn cây cao hơn trong năm nay.

content.grammarNotesEn: Countable or uncountable amount.

exactRecord.actualReviewNote: Output quantity, not annual-return rate.

content.definitionEn: To produce or provide a result, crop, or benefit.

examples.vi: Thí nghiệm tạo ra dữ liệu hữu ích.

content.grammarNotesEn: Transitive.

exactRecord.actualReviewNote: Data production no financial promise.

content.definitionEn: The income or return produced by an investment, often expressed as a rate.

content.grammarNotesEn: Financial vocabulary; no recommendation or rate asserted.

exactRecord.actualReviewNote: Return metric separated from crop output; specialist review required.

content.definitionEn: To allow another road user to move first.

content.definitionEn: Used to refer to the person or people being addressed.

content.grammarNotesEn: Same form singular and plural; Vietnamese context determines term.

content.definitionEn: Used to refer to anyone in a described situation.

content.grammarNotesEn: Generic you; not one specific listener.

exactRecord.actualReviewNote: Generic reference distinct from direct addressee.

content.definitionEn: Not having lived or existed for a long time.

examples.vi: Cây non cần được chống đỡ.

content.grammarNotesEn: Young person or organism.

exactRecord.actualReviewNote: Relative early age, not exact cutoff.

content.definitionEn: The babies or immature offspring of animals.

examples.vi: Chim bảo vệ các con non của mình.

content.grammarNotesEn: Plural collective young; no youngs.

exactRecord.actualReviewNote: Animal offspring distinct from young humans.

content.definitionEn: People at an early stage of life, considered as a group.

examples.vi: Chương trình khuyến khích người trẻ đọc sách.

content.grammarNotesEn: The young; plural collective use.

exactRecord.actualReviewNote: Nominal human collective distinct from adjective.

content.definitionEn: A child or young person.

content.grammarNotesEn: Countable; informal.

exactRecord.actualReviewNote: Person noun, not young adjective.

content.definitionEn: Used before a noun to relate it to the person or people addressed.

exactRecord.actualReviewNote: Possessive modifier distinct from yours pronoun.

exactRecord.actualReviewNote: Personal agency not automatic absence of assistance.

exactRecord.actualReviewNote: Reflexive object distinct from emphasis.
